data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘rosa’, meaning ‘rose’. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rosana usually hope their child will grow to embody rose, dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christian theology, the name Rosana holds profound spiritual significance. The rose is especially connected to the Virgin Mary, who is often depicted with a rose in her hands or at her feet in religious art. This name serves as a reminder of her motherly love and the virtues she embodied, making it an inspiring and powerful choice for a Christian name.
